description: The bar chart illustrates the scores of three models, SRPO-7B, GRPO-7B, and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B, across three benchmarks: MathVista, MathVerse, and Physics. The categories are listed on the horizontal axis, labeled "Benchmark", in the order of MathVista, MathVerse, and Physics. The vertical axis is labeled "Score" and has a linear scale ranging from 35 to 80, with tick labels at intervals of 5. Each benchmark is represented by a group of three bars, colored dark blue, blue, and light blue, corresponding to SRPO-7B, GRPO-7B, and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B, respectively. For MathVista, the scores are approximately 75.8, 72.3, and 68.2; for MathVerse, the scores are around 55.8, 52.9, and 46.3; and for Physics, the scores are about 60.6, 53.5, and 45.4. The bars within each group are not stacked, and the order of the bars corresponds to the legend. The bars are not sorted in a specific order across the benchmarks, but within each benchmark, the order is consistent with the legend. No bars are visually emphasized.
